> This is my first hardware project :) Since I'm gonna be working with an ESP32 Devkit v1 I though: "it'd be cool to build an USB hub before I run out of ports to plug my devices in" so I looked up for the neccesary chips and found they were pretty cheap. I've ended up with a first project that is both useful and cheap. :yayy:
